name: bilibili-home-clone
description: B 站首页 + 视频详情/播放 复刻（React + TypeScript 前端 / Express + SQLite 后端）

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.preview: concurrently -n backend,preview -c magenta,cyan "npm run start -w backend" "npm run preview -w frontend"
scripts.check: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
